senses.gloss: (√בץ, cmp. פצל) to peel; to split, branch off. Lam. R. introd.; Koh. R. to XII, 7 (interpret. אם הדרך Ezek. XXI, 26) (אם) אמה דבצלית an arm which branches off (direction post on the cross-road).

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 29b:3">Erub. 29ᵇ</cite> top <he>אי׳ זירתא</he> (ed. Pesaro a. Ar. <he>אפציל</he>, Var. <he>אבציל</he>) the bulb has grown to the length of a span.
